Construction Partners, Inc. Announces Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results

Company Reiterates Fiscal 2027 Outlook

DOTHAN, Ala., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Construction Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ: ROAD) ("CPI" or the "Company"), a vertically integrated civil infrastructure company specializing in the construction and maintenance of roadways in local markets throughout the Sunbelt, today announced financial and operating results for its fiscal fourth quarter and year ended September 30, 2026.

Fred J. (Jule) Smith, III, the Company's President and Chief Executive Officer, stated, "We delivered fourth quarter results in line with the preliminary financial ranges we announced in early November. During fiscal 2026, we advanced our ROAD 2030 goals through organic growth initiatives and seven strategic acquisitions that expanded our presence in high-growth markets, increased our market share, and strengthened vertical integration. Strong infrastructure demand and active commercial construction across the Sunbelt supported 7% organic revenue growth for the year. Disciplined execution across our operations, powered by nearly 7,700 employees, continues to translate this demand into improved results.

"Subsequent to the end of fiscal 2026, we completed three additional acquisitions expanding operations in attractive growth markets in Texas, Florida and Georgia."

Fiscal 2026 Financial Results

Revenue in fiscal 2026 was $3.674 billion, an increase of 31% compared to $2.812 billion in fiscal 2025.

Project backlog was approximately $3.29 billion at September 30, 2026, compared to $3.36 billion at June 30, 2026 and $3.03 billion at September 30, 2025.

Smith continued, "Following record fourth quarter revenue, our backlog entering fiscal 2027 strongly supports our guidance of 15% revenue growth. Additionally, in the first few weeks of fiscal 2027, we completed three acquisitions that added $65.0 million of backlog, substantially all of which we expect to convert to revenue in fiscal 2027."

Ned N. Fleming, III, the Company's Executive Chairman, stated, "The ten acquisitions we have completed since the start of fiscal 2026 are a testament to how repeatable this approach has become."
